value.rationale: A natural experimental question is whether anticorrelated velocity displacements entail any actual instantaneous subdiffusive MSD regime. This fully classifies the answer for the established two-layer OU model, including the sharp open mismatch wedge (1-q²,d≤1+q), the unique ordered crossover times, and a special exponential critical relaxation. The exact threshold corrects a tempting extrapolation from the older qualitative D2<D1 criterion, at finite nonzero relaxation-scale ratio. It is not an arbitrary sliced parameter value or a recomputed tabular moment; it supplies a complete measurable phase diagram with physical interpretability. Its scope is the pointwise local MSD exponent, not new stochastic density formulas.
